scripts.dev: docker compose up -d postgres redis && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm --parallel dev
scripts.lint: pnpm --recursive lint && node scripts/uv.mjs run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api
scripts.prompts:check: node scripts/uv.mjs run --project . --directory apps/api python -m app.cli.audit_prompts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --recursive typecheck && node scripts/uv.mjs run --project apps/api mypy apps/api/app
scripts.test: pnpm --recursive test && node scripts/uv.mjs run --project apps/api pytest apps/api/tests -q
scripts.test:critical: node scripts/uv.mjs run --project apps/api pytest apps/api/tests/critical -q
scripts.verify: pnpm check:comments && pnpm prompts:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
